news.headline: Jamauri McClure misses another game
news.summary: Tulane's running back will sit out Saturday's game against Southern Miss with a foot injury, and he has not played at all this season. The Green Wave have a bye next week and hope he can come back October 10 at Army.

news.headline: Will Hall faces his old team Saturday
news.summary: Tulane coach Will Hall meets Southern Miss on Saturday at Yulman Stadium. He used to be the head coach at Southern Miss, and quarterback Kadin Semonza said the Green Wave want to win this one for him.

news.headline: Cooper Helmke sets the Tulane field goal record
news.summary: Helmke's 58-yard kick at Kansas State on Saturday is the longest in school history, one yard past the mark Cairo Santos set in 2012. The redshirt freshman missed all of last season with a back injury and a hip injury.

news.headline: Only one Gator is on the injury list
news.summary: Receiver Eric Singleton is still listed as questionable for Saturday with a hurt ankle. No other Florida player is on the list, so the rest of the team is healthy for Ole Miss.

news.headline: Saturday's Ole Miss game is sold out
news.summary: Florida has sold every ticket for Saturday afternoon's game against Ole Miss in Gainesville. It is the 21st home game in a row the Gators have sold out.

news.headline: Eric Singleton might play Saturday against Ole Miss
news.summary: Coach Jon Sumrall said Monday that the receiver did more in practice than he has done since he hurt his ankle on September 5. Sumrall said they will warm Singleton up Saturday and play him if he is ready.

news.headline: Colin Simmons is cleared to play at Tennessee
news.summary: Colin Simmons hurt his foot last week against UTSA, but he is off the injury list and can play Saturday. Tight end Nick Townsend is out and running back Hollywood Smothers is still questionable.

news.headline: Arch Manning plays at Neyland Stadium for the first time
news.summary: Manning said he has never been to Knoxville, where his uncle Peyton played, and that he is excited for the noise. Texas is ranked No. 1 and plays No. 14 Tennessee there Saturday morning.

news.headline: Hollywood Smothers is questionable for Tennessee
news.summary: Texas listed running back Hollywood Smothers as questionable for Saturday's game at Tennessee. He leads the Longhorns in rushing this season.

news.headline: Two Saints are out for Sunday's home game
news.summary: Receiver Barion Brown and lineman Christen Miller will not play against the Raiders. Cornerback Martin Emerson practiced for the first time this week and is listed as a maybe.

news.headline: Cam Jordan is back on the field
news.summary: Cam Jordan hurt his hamstring in training camp and missed the first game of the season. He played Sunday at Baltimore and made two tackles in the win.

news.headline: Chase Young practices fully on Thursday
news.summary: The Saints pass rusher took part in all of Thursday's practice, and safety Jonas Sanker and lineman Nathan Shepherd did too. Receiver Barion Brown, cornerback Martin Emerson and lineman Christen Miller sat out again, and running back Travis Etienne was limited.

news.headline: IUP sweeps Seton Hill in conference opener
news.summary: The Crimson Hawks won 25-23, 25-22, 25-17 at Seton Hill on Friday in their first conference match of the year. Delaney Concannon and Kyra Schmidt each had 8 kills, and IUP is 9-3 and has not lost since August 29.

news.headline: Peyton Belcher has her best day of the season
news.summary: Peyton had 8 kills in Friday's win over Millersville, more than anyone else on the team. It is the most she has had in a match this year, and she missed on only one of her 14 swings.

news.headline: IUP wins twice in West Virginia
news.summary: The Crimson Hawks beat Shepherd and then Millersville on Friday and did not lose a set in either match. IUP has now won seven in a row and is 8-3.

news.headline: Yankees play two today because of the storm
news.summary: A big storm is coming to New York this weekend, so Saturday's game was called off and moved up to today. The Yankees and the Orioles play at 3:05 PM our time and again about 6:05 PM.

news.headline: Yankees come back to beat the Rays 6-4
news.summary: New York fell behind 4-0 on Thursday night and scored six times to win it. Rookie George Lombard Jr. drove in three runs, including a two-run home run in the eighth inning.

news.headline: Aaron Judge aims for Game 1 on Tuesday
news.summary: Judge said the plan is to have his body ready for the first playoff game at Yankee Stadium on Tuesday. He has been out since September 16 with a calf strain, and manager Aaron Boone said the team is getting ready to play without him.

news.headline: Warren Easton falls to Brother Martin
news.summary: Brother Martin scored early and often Friday night and won 56-6. Warren Easton is 0-3 and plays at Zachary next Friday.
